# ai_model — the occupancy CNN as C

Generated by **ST Edge AI Core 4.0.1** (`stedgeai generate`, target `stm32u5`,
`st-ai` C API) from `ml/results/occupancy_cnn.onnx` — the Gate 3 model, tagged
`phase3-model`. Do not edit by hand; regenerate instead:

```bash
/opt/ST/STEdgeAI/4.0/Utilities/linux/stedgeai generate \
    --model ml/results/occupancy_cnn.onnx --target stm32u5 --name occupancy \
    --workspace ml/runs/st/ws --output ml/runs/st/gen
cp ml/runs/st/gen/occupancy*.[ch] ml/runs/st/gen/LICENSE.txt firmware/vendor/ai_model/
```

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `occupancy.c/.h` | the network: layer graph, `stai_occupancy_*` API |
| `occupancy_data.c/.h` | the 11,091 trained weights, 44,364 bytes, as a `const` array in flash |
| `occupancy_details.h` | debug/inspection metadata |
| `occupancy_generate_report.txt` | the tool's report: layers, MACC, memory |

**Not in this directory:** ST's runtime library
(`NetworkRuntime1201_CM33_GCC.a`) and its headers. They are part of the ST
Edge AI install and are linked from there by `build.rs` (`STEDGEAI_DIR`,
default `/opt/ST/STEdgeAI/4.0`), not redistributed in this repo.

**Licence:** these files are ST's, under ST's SLA0104 (`LICENSE.txt` here), not
the repository's MIT licence. Among its terms, the code may only run on ST
devices — which an STM32U585 is.
